topline.theme: A 968-999 SIL brand-anchor site has no slack in features — the leverage is in proof consolidation and reliability hygiene. Two threads: (1) the site emits ~30 public proof JSONs but /status/ hand-fetches 10 of them with zero freshness contract — merge them into ONE self-grading trust manifest that an AI agent can verify in a single fetch. (2) Three reliability surfaces are asserted but unproven or racing — the Worker DR-cache, the TT default-policy enforce-readiness, and 7 self-committing workflows that push without rebase. Close the gap between 'we built it' and 'it is proven and won't fight itself.' Note: field-win.json has now CONFIRMED (hasConfirmed:true) — the board's ORIGIN-MIGRATION carry is stale and reconciles to DONE this session.

founderEvidence: Goal-chain /start -> /audit -> /implement -> /closeout with explicit ask: genius-level creative thinking, personalized to THIS project's real lists/flags/blockers. Personalization anchors: TASK_BOARD 'Now (S183 runway)' open carries; S180/S181 brainstorm backlog (STATUS-PROOF-INDEX, AMBIENT-CANDIDATE-LEDGER, DR-CACHE-SMOKE); live evidence that /status/ fetches 10 /api/*.json files, field-win.json is now confirmed, and 7 workflows lack rebase. Founder-gated items (RICHER-IGNIS-LAYER decision, vaultsparked-proof.js delete, nav-sheet device verify, TT enforce-FLIP per SOUL #3) are explicitly OUT of agent scope and listed as skipped/blocked.

items.summary: The site publishes ~30 public proof JSONs, and /status/ hand-fetches 10 of them on every load with no freshness contract. Merge the proof-relevant feeds into one CI-generated /api/status-proof.json and have /status/ read a single surface.
items.why: Ten parallel fetches collapse to one RTT, and the manifest becomes a trust instrument instead of a directory of files. Self-grading is the genius layer: each embedded proof carries its source generatedAt plus a computed staleness flag, and the manifest exposes a top-level worstStale + trustScore, so /status/ can render a per-signal freshness clock (green/amber/red) that no studio site does. Info-finding outcome: a visitor or AI agent verifies the studio's entire live posture in one fetch.
items.recipe: Add scripts/build-status-proof.mjs that reads api/{uptime,field-win,ai-discovery-health,ci-status,site-health,staging-health,geo-vitals,field-verdicts,public-status,security-posture}.json, stamps each with freshnessSeconds + stale boolean (vs its own generatedAt), computes top-level worstStale/trustScore, writes api/status-proof.json (publicSafe:true, sealed-vault respected). Wire into the existing proof-generation workflow + build:check drift gate; point status/index.html at the single file with graceful per-key fallback. Add a <link rel='alternate' type='application/json' href='/api/status-proof.json'> + /agents.json cross-link so agents discover it.

items.summary: The P0 carry blamed uptime-probe.yml, but 7 self-committing scheduled workflows push without 'git pull --rebase' first, so any of them can lose a race when a human/agent push lands in the same window. Generalize the fix to the whole class.
items.why: Avoidable CI failure noise that self-heals but erodes trust in the green dashboard and can drop a generated artifact for a cycle. Fixing the class (not the one observed instance) is the durable move. Info-finding outcome: scheduled proof refreshes stop failing on benign races.
items.recipe: In each of the 7 NO-REBASE workflows (ci-status-beacon, leaderboard-api, member-seo, og-images, rum-pull, uptime-probe, vault-narrative), add 'git pull --rebase --autostash origin main' immediately before the push step (guard with || true only where a detached/no-op state is expected). Validate every edited YAML with: npx --yes js-yaml <file> >/dev/null (per the validate-workflow-yaml memory) before committing.

items.summary: The Worker disaster-recovery cache (serves stale HTML on a double-5xx, emits X-VS-Disaster-Recovery: stale) is asserted in worker-lib.mjs but never exercised by a test. Add a smoke test that forces the double-5xx path and asserts the DR header.
items.why: An untested failover is a hope, not a guarantee — the only time you find out it's broken is during the outage it was built for. A deterministic test promotes the DR layer from 'assumed' to 'proven' and guards against silent regression. Info-finding outcome: CI proves the site degrades gracefully instead of hanging.
items.recipe: Add tests/dr-cache.spec.js (Node/worker-harness style matching existing cloudflare tests) that stubs originFetch to return two consecutive 5xx, invokes the worker-lib handler, and asserts response is the cached body + header X-VS-Disaster-Recovery: stale. Wire into the test suite run by build:check. Reference: cloudflare/worker-lib.mjs (X-VS-Disaster-Recovery).

items.summary: Ambient-bundle split decisions live in a volatile .cache/ambient-split-candidates.json with no committed rationale. Promote it to a reason-coded ledger (sitewide / route-scoped / hook-scoped / keep) so future split waves are data-driven, not re-derived.
items.why: Each ambient-split wave currently re-litigates which engines belong in the cold path; a committed ledger with reason codes makes the next wave a lookup, not an investigation, and documents why each engine is where it is. Info-finding outcome: the cold-path budget has an auditable provenance trail.
items.recipe: Add scripts/build-ambient-ledger.mjs that reads the candidate cache + current ambient block composition and writes docs/AMBIENT_LEDGER.md (or context/ambient-ledger.json) with {asset, placement, reasonCode, lastReviewed}. Seed reason codes from the existing S147/S180 split decisions. Optionally gate drift in build:check.
